title: Library — choose the composition
question: Books you've read, plan to read, and are reading now; click a book for its details and write as many notes as you like. Same world. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: The open book
options.lineage: a reading journal lying open: the book on the left page, your notes on the right
options.thesis: The book you click opens as a two-page spread — its details on the left page (author, year, pages, genre, started/finished, rating, a line of description), your notes on the right as dated entries with a writing line at the foot. The three shelves are a compact rail beside it: Reading now on top, then To read and Read as ruled lists.
materials: a shelf rail of ruled rows
the open book as the page's one white card, split by a gutter
options.viewport: Band: 'Library', italic '1 reading · 6 to read · 14 read this year'. Paper: left 4/12 the rail — 'Reading now' (title, author, page 142 of 320), 'To read' list, 'Read' list with ratings; right 8/12 the open book card: left page details, right page notes (each with a date) and 'Write a note' at the foot. Add a book: an inline line at the end of To read.
options.risk: With many books the rail gets long; the spread needs a book selected to mean anything (defaults to the one you're reading).

regions.label: To read (ruled list) + Add a book
Open book — left page: details, rating, description
Open book — right page: dated notes + Write a note

options.label: Index cards
options.lineage: a card catalogue: one ruled index card per book, drawn from the drawer
options.thesis: Every book is a ruled index card in a grid — title, italic author, shelf, rating dots — grouped under Reading now / To read / Read. Clicking a card lifts it as the page's one white card at the top with full details, and the notes column runs beneath it with a writing line.
materials: ruled index cards on paper (no shadow)
the lifted card is the one white card
options.viewport: Band: 'Library', italic counts. Paper: the lifted book (white card): title, author, details row, description, then 'Notes' entries and the writing line; beneath, three shelves of index cards, 3 across: 'Reading now' (one card, with page progress), 'To read', 'Read'. 'Add a book' as a blank card at the end of To read.
options.risk: Cards of equal size are the category's default; long titles and many notes push the shelves far down.

regions.label: Lifted book (card): details · description · notes + Write a note

options.label: Catalogue table with a detail column
options.lineage: the library's accession register: one ruled line per book
options.thesis: One ruled table of every book — title, author, shelf, rating, started/finished — with shelf filters above it and the book you're reading pinned at the top. The clicked book's details and notes open in a right column, notes as dated entries with a writing line.
materials: a ruled register with column heads
text-toggle filters (All · Reading · To read · Read)
the detail column as the one white card
rating as five dots in the row
options.viewport: Band: 'Library', italic counts. Paper: left 7/12 — filters row, then the register: Reading now pinned, then To read, then Read (finished date, rating); 'Add a book' line at the foot. Right 5/12 — the open book card: title, author, details, description, 'Notes' with dated entries and the writing line.
options.risk: Reads as admin; the row per book is dense and the notes column can be narrow at 1180px.
